$comment.about: MEC (Manara organisation 13) iftar sponsorship for Ramadan 2027, replacing the hidden Wix products Individual, Quarter, Half and Full Iftar. Import with: php artisan form:import 13 database/forms/mec-iftar-sponsorship.json (add --dry-run first). It imports switched OFF (is_active false). The sponsor picks a level; the server charges that level's price (settings.fee.byChoice), times the number of iftars for Individual Iftar only. Quarter, Half and Full Iftar each reserve one day from settings.reservation.dates: once a day is held it is no longer offered (App\Support\FormReservations). Card payments go through MEC's own Stripe Connect account. Before switching it on, go through mecToFill: with no days listed, Quarter, Half and Full Iftar cannot be chosen (the day question offers nothing), while Individual Iftar still works.
mecWording: The four level names and prices are MEC's own Wix products as they stood on 2026-09-08: Individual Iftar 18 USD, Quarter Iftar 450 USD, Half Iftar 950 USD, Full Iftar 1900 USD.

Individual Iftar sold by quantity on Wix; Quarter, Half and Full Iftar carried MEC's note "To reserve your day email office@meccharlotte.org for availability", which this form replaces by letting the sponsor pick an open day.
"Iftar Sponsorship": MEC's own product naming on Wix in 2024 ("Iftar Sponsorship for 50 people" / "for 100 people").
scaffolding: The question labels (Name, Email, Phone, Sponsorship, Number of Individual Iftars, Day to reserve) and their help lines are form scaffolding, not MEC's text; MEC may reword them.
mecToFill: THE DAYS THAT CAN BE RESERVED (settings.reservation.dates), as YYYY-MM-DD, one per iftar evening MEC offers in Ramadan 2027. The list is empty: MEC has not said which evenings it offers.
CONFIRM THE 2027 PRICES of the four levels (settings.fee.byChoice.prices[].amount, now MEC's 2026 Wix prices).

CONFIRM that one reserved day belongs to one sponsor whatever the level (as built: a Quarter Iftar takes the whole day off the list). If MEC lets up to four Quarter sponsors, or two Half sponsors, share one evening, that needs a change before import.
Optional: a maximum number of Individual Iftars per registration (the max of the "people" question). None is set; the platform never accepts more than 1000.
opens_at / closes_at for Ramadan 2027 (both null), and optionally notifyEmails, successTitle, successBody and a description. MEC has written none for this form, so none is invented here.

fields.name: iftar_day
fields.label: Day to reserve
fields.help: Quarter, Half and Full Iftar only.
